summary:
BioTelemetry is an offline-first, edge-native health monitoring platform engineered for deep-space exploration missions where speed-of-light communication delays and Loss of Signal (LOS) blackouts prevent real-time Earth support.

Built as a high-reliability Progressive Web App (PWA) with client-side IndexedDB persistence, the platform continuously captures real-time physiological telemetry, guided multimodal self-exams (SANS ultrasound, radiation skin scores, glucose), and daily wellness check-ins. On-device rule engines and AI flight surgeon consultation evaluate risks against NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) baselines locally, ensuring zero data loss and autonomous clinical decision support during deep-space transit before seamlessly synchronizing with Earth upon signal reacquisition.

BioTelemetry: Autonomous Crew Bio-Resilience Architecture

Project Overview

BioTelemetry is an offline-first, edge-native crew health and biotelemetry platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge to safeguard astronaut physiological resilience during long-duration exploration missions across Low Earth Orbit (ISS), the Moon (Artemis / Lunar Gateway), and Mars transit.

During deep-space voyages, communication latency spans from seconds up to 22–44 minutes roundtrip, punctuated by frequent Loss of Signal (LOS) blackouts caused by planetary occlusion, solar conjunctions, and orbital reentry plasma. BioTelemetry functions as an autonomous medical edge node aboard the spacecraft, enabling continuous onboard monitoring, zero-loss telemetry persistence, and deterministic clinical triage without requiring real-time Earth connectivity.

Preview unavailable Figure 1: Centralized BioTelemetry Mission Dashboard featuring the interactive 3D Anatomical Body Map and the real-time 100 Hz Lead-II ECG waveform monitor.

How the System Works

The platform operates as a continuous closed-loop bio-resilience engine:

  1. Continuous Telemetry Acquisition:
    Ingests and renders high-frequency biometrics, including real-time 100 Hz Lead-II electrocardiogram (ECG) waveforms, heart rate (HR), pulse oximetry (SpO2\text{SpO}_2SpO2​), core body temperature, respiration rate, heart rate variability (HRV / RMSSD), continuous blood pressure (systolic/diastolic), capillary blood glucose, leukocyte count (WBC\text{WBC}WBC / immune deconditioning), and ambient cosmic/solar radiation flux (μSv/h\mu\text{Sv/h}μSv/h).
    • Interactive 3D Anatomical Body Map: Live visualization across six critical organ systems (Brain/SANS, Cardiovascular, Pulmonary, Endocrine/Metabolic, Musculoskeletal/ARED, and Dermal/Immune).
    • Multimodal Guided Clinical Self-Exams: Standardized examination workflows for Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS) closed-eyelid optic nerve sheath ultrasound, dermal radiation erythema scoring, and capillary glucometer checks.
    • Daily Countermeasures & Circadian Tracking: Mission day routines, microgravity resistive exercise logs, and sleep/fatigue habituation tracking.
  2. NASA OSDR Baseline Calibration & Alerting:
    An onboard deterministic edge engine benchmarks telemetry against empirical spaceflight datasets (NASA Open Science Data Repository - OSDR, including OSD-575 and OSD-120). De-duplicated, multi-severity alerts (INFO, WARNING, CRITICAL) prompt crew action and recommend clinical countermeasures while preventing alarm fatigue.

Preview unavailable Figure 2: Daily Crew Check-In interface capturing sleep timing, circadian recovery, subjective fatigue, and stress alongside active telemetry context.

Offline-First Architecture & Edge Resilience

BioTelemetry is engineered from the ground up under a local-first, cloud-opportunistic paradigm:

  • Zero-Loss Local Storage (IndexedDB + Dexie.js):
    All telemetry streams, crew check-ins, clinical self-exams, and countermeasure logs write immediately to client-side ACID-compliant IndexedDB storage queues. Workflows remain 100% operational during complete communication blackouts or device power recycles.
  • Service Worker & Precaching (Workbox):
    The Progressive Web App (PWA) precaches static assets and UI runtimes for instantaneous offline boots. Strict NetworkOnly strategies are enforced across telemetry APIs to prevent stale cached vitals from ever masquerading as live astronaut biometrics.
  • Autonomous Multi-Tier Synchronization:
    When an Earth or orbital relay communication lock is restored, queued records automatically batch-synchronize with the cloud backend using FastAPI and Supabase PostgreSQL (enforcing Row-Level Security), ensuring full ground-team situational awareness without burdening the flight crew.

Artificial Intelligence & Decision Support

BioTelemetry integrates onboard conversational intelligence powered by GroqCloud and open-weight models (openai/gpt-oss-120b, llama-3.3-70b-versatile) alongside hands-free Groq Whisper voice transcription:

  • AI Flight Surgeon Consultation:
    Assists the crew with synthesizing multi-system biometric trends, evaluating symptom context, and generating structured SBAR (Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation) medical briefs ready for ground transmission upon signal reacquisition.
  • Multimodal Diagnostics & Graceful Fallback:
    Clinical self-exam imaging leverages Gemini Vision when online and seamlessly degrades to deterministic onboard clinical inspection protocols (protocol-offline) during communication outages.
  • Safety, Privacy & Explainability:
    AI capabilities are strictly decision-support aids designed to reduce cognitive load under isolation; all automated outputs explicitly communicate confidence bounds, cite reference NASA baseline datasets, and preserve clinical authority for human medical personnel.

Preview unavailable Figure 3: AI Flight Surgeon Assistant providing clinical summaries, recommended countermeasures, SANS tracking, and SBAR ground escalation protocols.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend Framework: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS delivering a high-performance, dark aerospace UI.
  • Edge & Offline Runtime: Progressive Web App (PWA), Workbox service workers, and Dexie.js IndexedDB for zero-loss offline queuing.
  • Waveform & 3D Visuals: HTML5 Canvas for 60 FPS 100 Hz Lead-II ECG oscilloscope and Three.js for interactive 3D anatomical modeling.
  • Backend & Edge Services: Python, FastAPI, Mangum, and Vercel Serverless RESTful telemetry and sync APIs.
  • Cloud Persistence: Supabase PostgreSQL with granular Row-Level Security (RLS) for ground mission control logs.
  • Artificial Intelligence: GroqCloud (openai/gpt-oss-120b), Whisper speech-to-text, and Google Gemini Vision for multimodal scans.
  • Validation Suite: Comprehensive automated test suite with 40/40 passing unit and integration tests across offline stores.

Innovation and Spaceflight Impact

  1. Elimination of the Cloud Bottleneck:
    Decouples day-to-day clinical workflows from Earth connectivity, allowing deep-space exploration crews to operate safely beyond Low Earth Orbit.
  2. Empirical Spaceflight Calibration:
    Directly incorporates NASA OSDR baseline data to account for microgravity cephalic fluid shifts, cosmic radiation accumulation, and circadian disruption.
  3. Reduced Cognitive Burden:
    Combines multi-sensor telemetry, hands-free voice interaction, and structured clinical self-exams into a unified, high-contrast dark console optimized for operational spaceflight environments.
